mapper.select: SELECT C.ID , COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR (START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , "NO" , U.NAME FROM COURSE C INNER JOIN COURSE_TUTOR CT ON C.ID = CT.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CT.TUTOR_ID = U.ID

SELECT C.ID , COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR (START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , "NO" , U.NAME FROM COURSE C INNER JOIN COURSE_TUTOR CT ON C.ID = CT.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN "USER" U ON CT.TUTOR_ID = U.ID WHERE C.ID = #{_parameter}

SELECT C."NO" , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR (START_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , C.ID FROM COURSE c WHERE C.ID = (SELECT COURSE_ID FROM COURSE_STUDENT WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM "USER" WHERE ID = #{_parameter}))

SELECT U.NAME , u.BASE_ROLE , u.CRT_DT , u.DEL_YN , u.GITHUB_URL , u.ID , u.LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , u.MDFY_DT , u.PWD , u.PWD_CHANGE_DT , u.PWD_FAIL_CNT FROM "USER" u WHERE U.BASE_ROLE =(SELECT R.ROLE_ID FROM "ROLE" r WHERE R.ROLE_ID = 'ROLE_STUDENT')

SELECT U.NAME , u.BASE_ROLE , u.CRT_DT , u.DEL_YN , u.GITHUB_URL , u.ID , u.LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE , u.MDFY_DT , u.PWD , u.PWD_CHANGE_DT , u.PWD_FAIL_CNT FROM "USER" u WHERE U.BASE_ROLE =(SELECT R.ROLE_ID FROM "ROLE" r WHERE R.ROLE_ID = 'ROLE_TUTOR')
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'CO-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_COURSE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO COURSE ( ID , COURSE_NAME , NO , START_DATE , END_DATED) VALUES (#{id} , #{courseName} , #{no} , #{startDate} , #{endDated} )

SELECT 'CU-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_COURSE_TUTOR_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO COURSE_TUTOR (ID ,TUTOR_ID ,COURSE_ID) VALUES (#{id} ,#{tutorId} ,#{courseId})

SELECT 'CT-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_COURSE_STUDENT_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO COURSE_STUDENT (ID ,COURSE_ID ,USER_ID) VALUES (#{id} ,#{courseId} ,#{studentId})
